BiblicalUsage: Toah is one link in the line of Samuel. The Chronicler traces Elkanah through Jeroham and Eliel to Toah, and the King James spells the name Toah where the lexicon has Toach.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the chain is the point: Samuel's father stands on the shoulders of men whose only record is a name in a list, and Toah is one of them.
